hints.title: Check Suffix Uniqueness
hints.text: Each operation removes the first 3 elements of the remaining array.

hints.title: Suffix Slices
hints.text: After k operations, the remaining elements form the suffix nums[3 * k:].

hints.title: Find Earliest Valid Suffix
hints.text: Find the smallest k >= 0 such that all elements in nums[3 * k:] are distinct.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating element-by-element without batching in chunks of 3 diverges from the operation rules.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set creation uses O(n) temporary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects understanding of step-3 prefix trimming and checking suffix set cardinality.
